blocks.text: Mutation genetic paigham ke mawad mein tabdeeli hai. Mutations chhoti, jaise aik ya chand nucleotides ki tabdeeli, se le kar bari, jaise chromosome ke bare hisse ya poore chromosome ki tabdeeli, tak hoti hain.

items: Point mutations: sirf aik ya chand nucleotides badalti hain.
Chromosomal mutations: genes ki jagah ya chromosomes ki banawat ya tadaad mein bari tabdeeliyan.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Mutations paida karne wale awamil mutagens kehlate hain, aur jis jandar ya cell mein mutation ho woh mutant kehlata hai.

blocks.prompt: Mutagen aur mutant mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Mutagen mutation paida karta hai; mutant woh jandar ya cell hai jis mein mutation ho.

items: Mutation: genetic paigham mein tabdeeli, aik nucleotide se poore chromosome tak.
Size ke lehaaz se do qismein: point aur chromosomal.
